fixture_note: Divergent generates a bounded receipt-compatibility proof that was absent from intake. Independent evidence supports it through downstream operators, so it is selected over every intake option and clears the ALLOW gate.

intake.problem_statement: Three candidate work items compete for the next build slot across the Cognitive Routing Layer and its receipt consumer: expand the runtime, package the offer, or reconcile documentation. The team needs an evidence-backed next step that can establish integration compatibility without changing production systems.

options.label: Expand the runtime with a production model adapter
options.mechanism: Implement a production model adapter and extend the runtime before collecting any compatibility evidence from a receipt consumer.
options.tradeoff: Adds an external integration surface before proving the existing receipt contract works end to end.

options.label: Package the assessment service for sale
options.mechanism: Assemble buyer-facing collateral, pricing tiers, and a proposal template from existing assessment content.
options.tradeoff: Commits to a commercial claim before any buyer evidence exists.

options.label: Run a bounded receipt-compatibility proof
options.mechanism: Feed a representative fixture through the existing deterministic runner, give the resulting receipt to the consumer, and record any schema or contract mismatch without modifying production systems.
options.tradeoff: Uses the build slot on a constrained proof rather than feature expansion or buyer-facing packaging.

claims.statement: Three materially distinct mechanisms are available: expand the runtime, package the offer, or generate compatibility evidence with a bounded proof.

defects.statement: Packaging assumes demand that no evidence in this run measures.
defects.remediation: Collect two buyer conversations with recorded willingness to pay before packaging.

defects.statement: The production adapter scope is not measured, so its fit within one build slot is asserted rather than established.
defects.remediation: Timebox a compatibility proof and record the resulting interface findings before estimating the production adapter.

claims.statement: The bounded proof is the only candidate whose scope is bounded by repository, test, and interface evidence rather than an unmeasured commercial or implementation assumption.

effects.statement: The bounded proof records a repeatable receipt-consumer compatibility baseline, so later expansion starts from observed constraints rather than inferred interface behaviour.
effects.follows_from: A bounded proof produces receipt compatibility findings.

claims.statement: A compatibility proof creates the observed receipt boundary that a later production expansion must preserve.
